project_woodshed_summary: A practice room for piano, guitar, ukulele, wind synth and pads.
project_woodshed_description: Woodshed listens through the microphone or MIDI, plays along, and turns practice into learning paths: ear training, rhythm, scales, voicings and songs, with progress you can see.
project_narrator_summary: Reads PDFs, EPUBs and text aloud with the words lit up as it goes.
project_narrator_description: Drop in a book or paste an article and Narrator reads it to you, highlighting each word. It uses your system voices or a neural voice that runs entirely in the browser.
project_listplay_summary: My Spotify playlists, plus a monthly playlist of my top songs.
project_listplay_description: A small client for the Spotify Web API: sign in, browse your playlists, and build a playlist from the songs you played most this month.
project_site_summary: The site you're on, self-hosted on my homelab.
project_site_description: SvelteKit and Svelte 5 on a Node server in my homelab, built with a Nix flake. The intro circuits are routed live in your browser each time you visit.
about_meta: About Gaspard Michel Etienne, a full-stack software engineer in Boston, and about this website.
about_lede: I'm a full-stack software engineer based in Boston. I've spent my career building web applications that people rely on at work during the day, and my evenings building fun tools I want for myself.
about_work_intro: I'm inquisitive. I like owning features end to end. I love digging deep to understand the problem space and working across the stack to come up with innovative solutions. From the infrastructure to the data layer, to the back end, and to the user interface, I enjoy working on each level. I love seeing the whole path, which is what allows me to craft great user experiences for clients.
about_work_interfaces_body: Svelte, React and TypeScript. I care about the details people feel and their experience using the interfaces that I build: quick loads, clear states, consistent UIs and pages that are accessible.
about_work_data_body: Node.js, Python, Temporal, Airflow, GraphQL and PostgreSQL. Schemas that model the domain honestly, pipelines that are reliable, and APIs that are pleasant to call.
about_work_infra_body: Containers, Kubernetes, CI and a homelab managed with Nix, where I run my own services and try ideas before they go anywhere else.
about_work_tools_body: Woodshed, Narrator and Listplay started as things I wanted to exist: a practice room for my instruments, a way to listen to long reads, and my most-played songs turned into a monthly playlist.
about_outside_music: Away from the keyboard I'm usually listening to music, playing soccer, travelling somewhere new, or experimenting in the kitchen. Music takes up the rest: I try to practise piano most days, mostly just sitting down, relaxing and jamming. I'm slowly learning a few other instruments, which is how {woodshed} started.
about_outside_creative: I also doodle here and there, paint sometimes and do a ton of other things, mostly as a way to relax and connect with my creative side, which you'll find in my {studio}.
about_site_intro: This site is my little corner of the internet: one place for everything I make and want to share, from apps and writing to music, drawings, paintings, photos, videos and more. It's less a polished portfolio than a workshop with the door open, so expect it to change as I build.
about_map_studio: Everything I make, from apps to doodles, each kind given the same space. See it as one wall or kind by kind.
about_map_blog: Notes on what I'm building and learning.
about_map_projects: Apps and tools that I want to use, such as {woodshed} and {narrator}.
about_intro_body: The circuits on the home page are drawn fresh on every visit. A small router written for this site lays traces out from the logo on a 16 pixel grid. Traces only run straight or at 45 degrees and never touch each other, the way a circuit board autorouter works. Then the G and E of the logo slide apart and an M is routed between them. Click the initials to fold them back and route a new board.

about_type_body: The mark is a G and an E sharing one ring. Headings are set in Bricolage Grotesque and long text in Newsreader. The colours come from the logo's gradient and from the colours in some of my doodles.
